posts.hook: one developer's github account was the way into 1password's backend
posts.caption: 1password says an attacker took customer names and emails but no vault data, an anthropic researcher posted a riemann proof cut from 17 million lines to 76,000, and reports say the justice department never formally investigated jensen huang before his return to nvidia. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: 1password says an attacker stole customer names and emails, ==not passwords or vaults==
slides.desc: a list of confirmed password-manager customers is ideal phishing material, so distrust the emails

slides.title: an anthropic researcher cut the machine-checked riemann proof to ==76,000 lines==
slides.desc: it was 17 million. the readme is plain: machine checks only, no mathematician has read it through

terms.gloss: verified step by step by proof-checking software, here lean

slides.title: openai's math release is nine manuscripts, not one, including a claimed linear programming result
slides.desc: openai calls the collection raw research data and says unformalized results could have issues

terms.gloss: finding the best outcome under a set of straight-line constraints

slides.title: reuters sources: the justice department ran no formal investigation of huang before his return
slides.desc: washington post sources: pentagon officials discussed an emergency-powers law as leverage on the board

slides.title: 42 state attorneys general oppose character.ai's plan to auction data from 21 million us accounts
slides.desc: over 2.1 million are registered to minors. private chats become an asset when the company fails

slides.title: coding agents fix a security flaw, then reintroduce it in a new session 26.7% of the time
slides.desc: about as often as agents that never saw it. they can fix security bugs but do not learn from them

slides.title: europe's hera probe finds the asteroid nasa hit in 2022 reshaped and tumbling
slides.desc: the crater is nearly as wide as the 151-meter rock, with hundreds of boulders drifting around it
